chunks: Whatever was in it from ʿAlī ibn al-Rayyān, I have narrated it from Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī Mājīlawayh—may Allah be pleased with him—from ʿAlī ibn Ibrāhīm, from his father, from ʿAlī ibn al-Rayyān.

key_terms.عَلِيِّ بْنِ الرَّيَّانِ: The narrator from whom these reports are transmitted
key_terms.عَنْ أَبِيهِ: From his father, indicating the next link in the chain

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to ʿAlī ibn al-Rayyān in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage records the sanad/isnad through which the author transmits reports from ʿAlī ibn al-Rayyān. Its significance lies in documenting the chain of transmission in hadith literature and preserving scholarly attribution.
